# proxmox_sdn_fabric_node (Resource)

Manages one node of a Proxmox VE SDN fabric through `/cluster/sdn/fabrics/node/{fabric_id}`. Interface, peer and allowed-IP entries stay Proxmox property strings. Fabric nodes stage like the other SDN objects and only take effect when `proxmox_sdn_apply` commits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Fabric nodes stay staged until proxmox_sdn_apply commits the SDN
# configuration. Interfaces are Proxmox property strings.
resource "proxmox_sdn_fabric_node" "node1" {
  fabric_id  = proxmox_sdn_fabric.ospf.fabric_id
  node_id    = "node1"
  protocol   = "ospf"
  ip         = "10.10.0.1"
  interfaces = ["name=eth1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_id` (String) Fabric the node belongs to. Changes require replacement.
- `node_id` (String) Node name inside the fabric. Changes require replacement.
- `protocol` (String) Fabric protocol: `openfabric`, `ospf`, `wireguard`, or `bgp`. Must match the fabric. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) CIDRs routable through this WireGuard node.
- `endpoint` (String) WireGuard endpoint of the node.
- `interfaces` (List of String) Interface entries as Proxmox property strings, for example `name=eth1` or `name=eth1,hello_multiplier=3`.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address of this node.
- `ip6` (String) IPv6 address of this node.
- `peers` (List of String) WireGuard peer entries as Proxmox property strings.
- `public_key` (String) WireGuard public key of the external node.
- `role` (String) WireGuard role: `internal` or `external`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `fabric_id/node_id` form.
- `pending` (Map of String) Properties Proxmox currently reports as staged but not committed, with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Proxmox staging state: `new` or `changed` while the node is not committed yet.
